snippet.title: Greed's Grub - Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Greed’s Grub is a FREE indie game on Steam.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3655930/Greeds_Grub

You're not here by choice. After some minor legal trouble, it's no big deal really…. though you can't even remember what you did.  you've been slapped with five days of community service. That’s how long you have to last. Then you’re free.

But it won't be easy.

Your punishment? Working at Greed’s Grub, a burger joint where the food’s questionable, the customers are weird, and the van you're in most certainly violates several health codes.


free to follow this channel or follow me on other apps/sites
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@rerep3s
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/rerep3s/

This is just a game I've been doing solo for like more than 3 months on an off. just wanted to publish a game for one of my new years resolutions.
